AllowedScope: App-local fixed-regime resolver, assay target and tests; use existing persisted configuration; no production runtime or defaults.
IndependentEngineeringAcceptance: Exact timing, correct death precedence, original-budget negative traces, durable replay, compatibility, material ledger and frozen budgets.
IndependentBiologicalAcceptance: Not applicable to this technical task. A sentinel cannot support stage viability or adoption.
FailureAndRollback: Reject if setup, ordering, invariants, budgets or restoration fail. Preserve old-budget deaths and candidate receipts.

AllowedScope: Measure actual exposure, choice, transfer and uptake before a scoped recipient or kinetic change.
IndependentEngineeringAcceptance: Real committed event identities and component balances; no observer mutation; legacy and dense performance.
IndependentBiologicalAcceptance: Independent recipient dose and time-to-uptake under measured matched conditions with full risk sets.
FailureAndRollback: Retain the old policy if dose, uptake or observed local mechanism cannot be distinguished.

AllowedScope: Distinguish actual activity and eligible work from internal role; constrain effective rates by stage.
IndependentEngineeringAcceptance: Deterministic measurement and rate integration; conserve budgets; replay old settings.
IndependentBiologicalAcceptance: Independent matched act/transition, resting and activity-linked power and water evidence.
FailureAndRollback: Keep observer-only results if power or task effects remain coupled or the cohort does not match.

AllowedScope: Use measured local body state, care and viable egg exports; preserve existing guard as comparator.
IndependentEngineeringAcceptance: Actual exports and retained budgets, source-anchored deterministic model and long paired failure controls.
IndependentBiologicalAcceptance: Independent stage-specific reserve, laying and viable brood prediction in admitted conditions.
FailureAndRollback: Retain local guard and original profiles if export, uptake and cost remain unseparated.

AllowedScope: Embryo viability and later active stage progression with measured timing and stage-specific funding and loss.
IndependentEngineeringAcceptance: Compare old-budget failures, new measured model and frozen histories; conservation, exact replay and admission.
IndependentBiologicalAcceptance: Independent conditional stage times and full-cohort hatch or competing death, plus active later stages and measured nutrition.
FailureAndRollback: No new biology or defaults from timing sentinel. If stage exposure or independent outcomes are missing, retain the technical-only label.

AllowedScope: Verify aligned observations first and address identified motor or local response error.
IndependentEngineeringAcceptance: Replay scan, access, contact and custody with old behavior control; dense history retained.
IndependentBiologicalAcceptance: New matched queen or first-worker groups with aligned counts, access contrasts and timings.
FailureAndRollback: Retain existing assumptions and explicitly unresolved bias if independent layout, timing or outcomes are unavailable.

AllowedScope: Bound local information, exploration and loaded delivery; address only identified discrepancy.
IndependentEngineeringAcceptance: Geometry, cue boundary, route and cargo invariants; actual load and arrival; observer off/on parity.
IndependentBiologicalAcceptance: Independent local discovery and return comparison including unmarked, absent and blocked conditions.
FailureAndRollback: Leave broad search claim open if candidate data only measure choice or final throughput.

AllowedScope: Separate marks, exposure, naive activation and completed trip from private route memory.
IndependentEngineeringAcceptance: Committed facts and causal cue controls; freeze old trails and paired cases; local-only inputs.
IndependentBiologicalAcceptance: Independent real-scout, naive departure and actual return outcomes under prespecified cue contrasts.
FailureAndRollback: Preserve null or negative contrasts and keep recruitment blocked when only acute cue choice agrees.

AllowedScope: Evaluate residual stage or cohort risk after observed supply, costs, reproduction and progression.
IndependentEngineeringAcceptance: Conservation, deterministic death/censor handling, stable age identity and replay of known depletion.
IndependentBiologicalAcceptance: Independent admitted cohort competing risk and stage survival with documented exposures.
FailureAndRollback: Keep cause unknown when unobserved and keep risk claim blocked on incomplete or unmatched follow-up.

AllowedScope: Match measured local work, materials and reachable coarse geometry without changing authority.
IndependentEngineeringAcceptance: Material conservation and physical connectivity, bounded observer overhead and durable geometry replay.
IndependentBiologicalAcceptance: Independent autonomous work, volume and soil movement through time with matched group or substrate contrast.
FailureAndRollback: Reject a shape-only fit and retain original settings if measured work and transport do not support the change.
